Name: The Wanderer
Description: Quentin Thexius, Rhapsody-in-Light, Pickle, and the sword formerly known as Nightfall.

Innate.Name: Greatest Steed
Innate.Description: You are mounted on Rhapsody, benefitting from their flying speed. One other ally of Small or Medium size can ride with you (mounting as a free action on their turn). You and your ally cannot be removed from Rhapsody's back against your will.

Actions.Name: InspiRATion
Actions.Description: When you take this Hero Action, you direct Pickle to encourage an ally. Until the start of your next turn, they have a +12 to all rolls.

Actions.Name: Keshet, The Edge of Possibility
Actions.Description: When you take this Hero Action, you direct Keshet, the Edge of Possibility to attack an enemy you can see within 60 feet. Roll 2d12+12. Keshet deals that much damage of a type it chooses (preferring vulnerabilities) and an ally you can see regains that many hit points.
